graph.name: Combine two style references
graph.description:
Compose two style references into a feature brief, then propose a prose pass for review.

Lesson: Named Compose Text inputs combine independent references; a template adds priorities before one style-transfer request.

Limitations: References express qualitative priorities. Prose cannot be guaranteed to be a numerical percentage blend.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Swap Imagery for restrained sound imagery while retaining the Rhythm source.
Prioritize imagery over rhythm in Priority; compare fact preservation, pauses and image count.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Before: She waited at the gate while the cold wind blew.

After: She waited at the gate. The wind had teeth.

Named Text inputs: rhythmReference.out → blend.section.Rhythm; imageryReference.out → blend.section.Imagery; blend.out → transfer.reference; reply.out → transfer.in; transfer → validate → review → apply.

Inputs override fallbacks: Connect both inputs; blank fallbacks do not enforce connection. Priorities are qualitative text, not percentage controls. Three Compose nodes cost zero calls; transfer costs at most one Prose call.

Cold gate · frozen scene (reply)
Purpose: Freeze the latest completed text-only gate reply.
Fixture: She waited at the gate while the cold wind blew. The courier had not arrived.
Inspect: Waiting, gate, cold wind and absent courier are the only story facts.

Influence A · short pauses (rhythmReference)
Purpose: Supply a reusable rhythm-only Text reference.
Inspect: Inspect standalone Text; bell and desk supply no scene facts.

Influence B · compact sensation (imageryReference)
Purpose: Supply an independent imagery-only Text reference.
Inspect: Inspect standalone Text; coat is not a gate-scene fact.

Join two named references (blend)
Purpose: Combine connected Text inputs with feature priorities.
Inspect: Both connected inputs replace blank fallbacks; Priority appears once.

Blend pause and cold image (transfer)
Purpose: Recast narration using the assembled feature brief.
Inspect: Check pauses/image count; metaphor must not establish literal injury.

Check blended narration (validate)
Purpose: Validate source-bound blend patches.
Inspect: Check protected gate/courier and authorized narration windows.

Review feature balance (review)
Purpose: Require rhythm, image and fact comparison.
Inspect: Find A's pauses and one B-like image; reject imported bell/desk/coat facts.

Offer blended gate prose (apply)
Purpose: Offer the final blended candidate.
Inspect: Full root Host result: compare gate facts, then Apply or Reject.

sections.name: RhythmSample
sections.text: Use short declarative sentences; pause when attention shifts. Original sample: The bell stopped. He stayed at the desk. Borrow rhythm only.

sections.name: ImagerySample
sections.text: Use one compact physical metaphor for an existing sensation. Original sample: The cold worried at the cuff of her coat. Borrow imagery only.

sections.name: Priority
sections.text: Keep waiting and absent courier legible first; then use A's pauses and at most one B-like cold-wind image. Never import sample facts.

transfer.title: Style Transfer
transfer.instructions: Retain waiting at gate, cold wind and absent courier. Use short pauses and at most one compact wind image. Add no clothing, injury, motive, arrival or elapsed time.
